punchline: Waiters who simply repeated the order back got average tips 70 percent higher than waiters who said "great" and "no problem".
thirty_sec: A boss asks an employee for two paper copies of everything, one in-house and one for the client. That's a week of work. The employee calmly says, "Two copies?" The boss explains, and it turns out the client never asked. The next question gets him to settle for digital backups, and the next morning's email says two digital backups will be fine. Chris Voss calls it mirroring.
